texts.facts: In the application for condonation of delay, it has been submitted that the impugned order passed on 01.05.2019 was received by the department on 16.05.2019. Thereafter, Sh. Hukam Singh, FSO of this case was on special duty from 21.05.2019 to 25.05.2019. 1 FSO was on earned leave. It has further been submitted that on 03.06.2019, 06.06.2019 & 11.06.2019, FSO attended various courts for hearing in departmental cases. Thereafter, the FSO was on earned leave from 19.06.2019 to 30.06.2019. It has been submitted that after going through the impugned order and material on record, FSO prepared detailed note with reasons to file appeal in the present case and forwarded the same to Sh. A. K. Singh, DO(HQ) to seek legal opinion as well as approval of Commissioner, Food Safety. DO (HQ) then forwarded the file to DO Prosecution/Deputy Legal Advisor on 02.07.2019 for his opinion. It has been submitted that DLA Prosecution gave detailed opinion on 09.07.2019 opining the matter fit for appeal and forwarded the file to Commissioner, Food Safety for approval. On 17.07.2019, Commissioner, Food Safety accorded his approval to file an appeal and on 18.07.2019, file was forwarded to Chief Public Prosecutor to file an appeal. Chief Public Prosecutor took some time to file the appeal. Thus, the appeal could not be filed within limitation period. Ld. Chief PP submitted that the delay is caused due to official reason and not a deliberate one. 3. Per contra, Ld. Counsel for respondents has submitted that this appeal is liable to be dismissed. It has been submitted that the limitation period is of 30 days and this court can maximum condone the delay for another 30 days.
texts.arguments: 5. Section 3.3.1 of The Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011 ("FSS Rules" in short) provides as under: "3.3.1 Appeal to Appellate tribunal 1. Limitation for filing appeal: Provided, however, that the Appellate Tribunal may allow a maximum of another 30 days to entertain an appeal if it is satisfied that there was sufficient cause for not filing the appeal within first 30 days."
